values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April-October) Sunday-Thursday / Friday-Saturday basic $12 / $15, electric 30A $21 / $27, electric 50A $23 / $29, family basic $20 / $22, family electric 30A $36 / $42, family electric 50A $40 / $46; off-season (November, and March) basic $12, electric $19-21. The Hermitage campground has no water hookups. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads) takes one reservation fee.

note: Hermitage-side campground on a peninsula of Pomme de Terre Lake: four loops of basic and electric sites (no water hookups), open March through November, with showers and water April through October. Loop 400's west-side basic sites sit above an open shore. The area has its own boat ramp, store and playground; the swim beach is separate. --Claude
